identityAssessment.finding: The imported 1492 feature lies in eastern Colombia, approximately 74.02 to 71.76 degrees west and 2.87 to 4.58 degrees north. Its label is read as the Indigenous Achagua people. Modern locations help identify the subject but do not verify a precise 1492 frontier.

scopeNotes: The historical shell-bead examples come from an attributed documentary synthesis, not an excavated assemblage with a demonstrated Achagua findspot.
No modern population estimate is represented as current.
Period endpoints group documented historical contexts; no foundation or extinction date is inferred.
